creative_direction.title: ESIK//80
creative_direction.genre: psychological outbreak thriller, mystery and grounded action anime
narrative_tone: explosive only in short readable bursts
creative_direction.visual_identity: Rain-darkened Neo-Geneva, face-recognition infrastructure, restrained charcoal and cold-blue frames, sparse deep-red identity marks, and familiar voices returning warmth to otherwise alien faces.
originality_guardrails: Do not imitate named anime, games, studios, characters, costumes, shots or signature powers.
FHD-80 never turns people into zombies or monsters.
Faces remain physically normal; alienation is conveyed through framing, sound and recognition failure.
Action must arise from evacuation, evidence, scarce treatment and human conflict rather than tournament escalation.
Every major opponent must have a defensible human objective.
